senses.gloss: m. (קְרַץ I) biting, cutting, destruction; only in אכל ק׳ (mostly pl. קַרְצִין, קוּרְ׳) (v. אֲכַל I) to inform against. [Targ. Is. LVIII, 1 אכלי ק׳ Ar., read with ed. Koh. only אכלי, quoted to prove the meaning of אכל = קרא, v. כְּלֵי II.] Targ. Prov. XI, 13 קֻרְצָא ed. Wil. (Ms. קורצין).
